_about: One entry per requirement: id, design section, what is checked, how, and passes (true, false, or null = not run yet). The orchestrator writes these from docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md. Issues list the ids they satisfy. These first entries are the design's invariants and the checks that already exist.

requirements.requirement: Agents never call each other. Research and personal agents reach memory only through DeskPort
requirements.check: Evaluator review of imports in agents/ and workers/

requirements.requirement: Each collection has one writer: keeper for records, dispatcher for tasks and inbox
requirements.check: npm run keeper:check

requirements.requirement: No LLM call decides merge, score, assignment, escalation or timers
requirements.check: check:llm test of imports, transitive (rules, dispatcher, sweeper, keeper never reach agents/shared/llm.ts)

requirements.requirement: A high-risk task waits for a coordinator, and only a coordinator's approval event is accepted
requirements.check: npm run keeper:check (approval cases)

requirements.requirement: Accept, Decline, Done and Problem work with the model unavailable
requirements.check: e2e field and coordinator specs with no model key

requirements.requirement: The event actor comes from the session or agent key, never the body. ?user= is refused through a tunnel
requirements.check: npm run api:check && npm run security:check

requirements.requirement: The sweeper times out unanswered tasks, sends check-ins, opens unreachable incidents and requeues stuck events
requirements.check: npm run sweeper:check

requirements.requirement: Typecheck, lint, build, replay tests and token checks pass
requirements.check: .github/workflows/ci.yml

requirements.requirement: The web app runs on ECS Fargate in at least two availability zones, defined in infrastructure as code
requirements.check: cdk synth / terraform plan shows two AZs; stopping one task keeps /login answering 200

requirements.requirement: The Brain runs as its own Fargate service, and a second Brain waits on the lease
requirements.check: Start two Brain tasks; exactly one processes events (meta lease holder)

requirements.requirement: No secret lives in a file on a host or in the repo; every secret comes from Secrets Manager
requirements.check: Grep of the deployed task definitions and repo finds no secret values; app boots with only Secrets Manager references

requirements.requirement: CloudTrail records every AWS API action; CloudWatch alarms fire on Brain loop stall and 5xx rate
requirements.check: Console or CLI evidence of the trail and alarms; a stopped Brain triggers the stall alarm

requirements.requirement: Opening a full phone number and every admin action write an audit entry: who, what, when
requirements.check: API test reads a masked number as the assigned volunteer and finds the audit entry

requirements.requirement: Deploys authenticate to AWS with GitHub OIDC; no long-lived AWS keys exist
requirements.check: Repo and Actions secrets contain no AWS access keys; deploy run log shows AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity

requirements.requirement: A version tag on main deploys; a failed health check rolls back
requirements.check: Tag a release; break /login in a test release and see the rollback

requirements.requirement: All database access goes through one repository module so DocumentDB stays possible
requirements.check: Evaluator review: no direct mongodb driver import outside lib/db.ts and the repository module

requirements.requirement: The fork runs on Dan's own Atlas cluster with fresh credentials; no hackathon key works
requirements.check: db:check passes against the new cluster; old URI and keys rejected

requirements.requirement: Every model call goes through modelFor()/send() to OpenRouter's US endpoint with gpt-oss-120b (gpt-oss-20b for small jobs), and production refuses to start on any other host
requirements.check: check:llm denylist of model hosts and SDK imports outside agents/shared/llm.ts; /api/health reports the model host; network log of a live chat turn shows only us.openrouter.ai (live part needs #5)

requirements.requirement: The Anthropic SDK and keys are gone
requirements.check: No @anthropic-ai/sdk in package.json or package-lock.json; no ANTHROPIC_ key in .env.example or any env read

requirements.requirement: Every tool call's arguments are parsed and schema-checked before running, and a tool outside the role's allowlist is refused
requirements.check: check:llm unit tests with mocked responses

requirements.requirement: Personal agents file events through their role tools on the live gpt-oss-120b model
requirements.check: agents/scripts/smoke.ts and contract-check.ts pass against the live model (needs the OpenRouter key from #5)

requirements.requirement: A model failure never reaches a person as a finished answer: finish_reason error or length, and a missing usage block, are handled, and the budget is never undercounted
requirements.check: check:llm tests for error, length and missing usage, streamed and not

requirements.requirement: No prompt promises a tool or capability the agent doesn't have
requirements.check: check:llm test: prompts mention no tool that toolsFor() doesn't define (e.g. web search)

requirements.requirement: No open-web search runs in the pilot build
requirements.check: No web_search tool in toolsFor(); news agent makes no search-API call (npm run check:llm)

requirements.requirement: The news agent turns NWS, FEMA and USGS feeds into schema-checked events with a dedupeKey
requirements.check: Replay of saved feed fixtures posts the expected events once each (npm run check:feeds)

requirements.requirement: A supplier or field team with an open incident gets matching contacts from the desk's directory
requirements.check: API test: vehicle_breakdown incident returns tow and tire contacts for that desk (npm run check:feeds)

requirements.requirement: Agency staff sign in through Cognito federated to an Entra ID or Okta test tenant
requirements.check: e2e login through a test IdP lands on the right role screen

requirements.requirement: A person with no login can file an emergency report, rate limited and marked public trust
requirements.check: API test: anonymous report accepted as source person, trust public; 11th report in a minute refused

requirements.requirement: Roles live in the database, are requested by the person and granted by a coordinator, and the grant is logged
requirements.check: API test of request, grant and the history entry

requirements.requirement: ?user= demo identity cannot be enabled in a production build
requirements.check: Production build with DEMO_MODE=1 still refuses ?user= (security:check)

requirements.requirement: Field dictation uses on-device recognition (processLocally: true) and falls back to typing; audio never goes to Google
requirements.check: e2e on Chrome: network log shows no speech request; unsupported browser shows the text box

requirements.requirement: Talk uses Amazon Transcribe and Polly behind a voice port
requirements.check: Integration test with the port's AWS provider; swapping the provider changes one config value

requirements.requirement: MapLibre is the only map renderer, with Esri basemaps and an OSM tile fallback
requirements.check: package.json has no leaflet or react-leaflet; with Esri blocked the map loads the fallback tiles

requirements.requirement: The shell (header, nav, footer, skip link) and /login use USWDS components and pass axe with no serious or critical violations, in light and dark mode
requirements.check: e2e test:a11y on a production build, in CI

requirements.requirement: Every product screen passes full-page axe with no serious or critical violations, in light and dark mode
requirements.check: e2e full-page axe on /, /field, /talk, /coordinator, /map, /ops in both themes, in CI

requirements.requirement: A shell or theme change never makes an existing screen less accessible than main, in either theme
requirements.check: Full-page axe serious/critical counts per screen and theme are no higher than main's baseline (ratchet), in CI

requirements.requirement: One screen set: field, talk, coordinator, desk, map, ops; /v2, /compare and /lab removed from the product build
requirements.check: Route list of the production build

requirements.requirement: The Mongo-backed checks (keeper, sweeper, api, security) run in CI against a throwaway database
requirements.check: CI job log shows each check passing

requirements.requirement: An IU tabletop scenario runs end to end through the event API: a call, a dispatch with approval, a breakdown and its re-plan
requirements.check: Feeds worker plays the IU drill timeline (D-0017) and the desk reaches the expected board state

requirements.requirement: A photo sent through /api/chat is described into text by the vision model (a `vision` purpose behind modelFor()), and the description, not raw image bytes, is what the agent acts on and files; the photo still attaches to the event
requirements.check: check:llm test: vision purpose routes to the vision model on the US host; a mocked image input yields a text description the agent files; photoUrl stays on the event

requirements.requirement: A desk is in exactly one mode, replay or live, stored in meta mode:<deskId> and written only by the feeds worker
requirements.check: Unit test of the mode schema; keeper:check confirms no other writer touches mode: documents

requirements.requirement: Starting a replay empties the desk's records (events, sites, needs, roads, shelters, zones, incidents, tasks, inbox, messages), reseeds users only, and touches no other desk
requirements.check: Mongo-backed check on two throwaway desks: board of the replayed desk is empty except users before the first timeline line, the other desk is unchanged

requirements.requirement: The replay posts every timeline line once, through postEvent(), in atS order, with observedAt from the recording and a dedupeKey carrying the runId
requirements.check: Mongo-backed check at high speed: event count and order match the timeline; a second run posts a second set

requirements.requirement: A 72 h scenario window plays in the chosen duration (default 30 min); pause holds the clock, resume continues
requirements.check: Unit test of deskNow() with a fake clock at 10, 30 and 60 min

requirements.requirement: The default Antakya timeline holds only real-sourced lines; the drill timeline holds only synthetic lines; the build script refuses a mix
requirements.check: npm test of scripts/build-replay.ts on the committed timelines and a mixed fixture

requirements.requirement: Only a signed-in person starts, pauses or stops a replay; agent keys, timers and unauthenticated calls cannot; a pilot desk refuses
requirements.check: npm run api:check cases for POST /api/desk/mode

requirements.requirement: Sweeper timers and personal agents read deskNow(deskId), so timeouts fire on the scenario clock
requirements.check: npm run sweeper:check with a replay clock at 144×

requirements.requirement: No product screen renders fixture data; an empty or failing desk shows the empty or error state, and every screen shows the mode banner
requirements.check: Production-build grep for fixtures/ imports outside tests, plus e2e on an empty desk

requirements.requirement: Quake alerts are a schema-checked alert kind and the keeper stores them
requirements.check: npm run keeper:check quake alert case
